intro.title: Navratna Bracelets
intro.descriptionHtml: Experience the harmonious energies of the Navgraha with Navratna Bracelets. Navratna refers to the nine precious gemstones representing the celestial bodies in Vedic astrology. These bracelets combine the healing properties of the nine gems, including Ruby, Pearl, Emerald, and more. Wearing a Navratna Bracelet is believed to bring balance, protection, and good fortune by aligning the planetary influences in your life.
